summary: "When I'm upset, I need affection" — and everything in that shape. Written by the person it is about.
invariants: AUTHORSHIP IS ABSOLUTE — edit() and remove() refuse when the caller is not the author. A profile of someone the other person can rewrite is a projection, not a profile.
author is never a parameter; it is always the caller. A remote entry is FORCED to their authorship rather than trusted from the payload.
SURFACED, NOT FILED — forMoment() pulls their entries when a rupture is logged, not in a tab you would have to think to open
a partner never sees their edit history. "She used to need X" turns a living document into a receipt.
§0.3 editing keeps the previous version — what someone needed two years ago is worth having too
§17.3 completionPercent is null and untouched sections are information, not a to-do list

unknown section or moment -> throws, listing the valid ones
empty or over-long entry -> throws, naming the limit
